label: G F40#0 gate rain base-vs-arm
brief: Fixed captures from the game of the Cloudreach biome (high cliffs, sky islands and wind) by day in rain, one place from four views (approach, gameplay, reverse and detail; left to right, top to bottom). Judge whether these views read as the key art's world at a shipping game's finish - palette, light, time of day, weather, value range, density, landmarks, depth - and anything that reads as a defect.
